collaboration.title: How to work with us
collaboration.hint: Select the partnership model for this client

tour.title: What this panel does
tour.intro: {count} stops, in the order a rate desk uses them. Each one opens the real page — this is your own panel, so anything you set up here stays.

dashboard.title: The morning screen
dashboard.body: Every rate, bot and channel in one view: what changed, what is waiting to be published, and whether your Telegram connection is alive.
dashboard.look: Bot status, recent rate changes and channel numbers — all live, no spreadsheet.

prices.title: Set your rates
prices.body: Buy and sell for every currency you deal in. Type one number, or set a base rate and let the panel work out the spread for each pair.
prices.look: Open a currency and change a rate — the panel keeps the history and the percentage move.

finalize.title: Approve, then publish
finalize.body: Nothing reaches your customers until someone approves it. A manager reviews the new rates, sees the generated image, and releases them.
finalize.look: The rendered rate image is built here from your own template before it goes out.

categories.title: Your currencies, your rules
categories.body: Define the currencies, pairs and price types you actually quote — cash, transfer, VIP — each with its own rounding and formatting.
categories.look: Add a price type and it appears on the panel, the channel post and the image.

templates.title: Your brand on every post
templates.body: The rate images are drawn on your template: your logo, colours, fonts and background. The editor is right here, no designer needed.
templates.look: Open a template and move a field — that is exactly what your customers will receive.

telegram.title: Telegram, automatically
telegram.body: Formatted rate messages and images go to your channel the moment rates are approved, and a bot answers price questions for your customers.
telegram.look: Channels, bots and the message that gets sent — all configured from this page.

analytics.title: Proof it is working
analytics.body: Rate history, publishing activity and channel reach, so you can see how often you move and how many people saw it.
analytics.look: Pick a range and compare — the same numbers your manager will ask for.

support.title: Stuck? Talk to us
support.body: Anything the panel will not do, or a rate that looks wrong — message our admins directly and a person answers.
support.look: These are live contacts; the same ones appear in the panel footer and on the site.
